subject: CarePlus PO endorsement and monthly invoice sequencing
messages:
From: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@careplushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@careplushealth.com
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: CarePlus PO requirements and invoicing cadence — question

Hi Logan,

Quick one from procurement as we prepare the PO for the upcoming pilot: can you confirm what fields are required on the PO and whether Redwood can support a consolidated monthly invoice across three CarePlus legal entities?

Specifically we need to know:
- Which PO fields must appear on the invoice (PO number, BU code, cost center, department code, SKU/line mapping?)
- Do you require separate POs per legal entity or can one master PO reference multiple entity IDs if line items map to each entity?
- Preferred invoice cadence (monthly consolidation vs weekly) and whether Redwood can run EOM cutoffs for net terms alignment
- Standard net terms and whether Redwood will consider net60 for enterprise customers; also any early-payment discounts you offer

I attached our PO template for reference. If you can send a short summary and a sample pricing matrix that shows invoice grouping behavior, that would help speed approvals.

Thanks,
Sara Nolan
Sr. Procurement Manager
CarePlus Health
[Attachment: careplus_po_template.pdf (PDF)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@careplushealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: CarePlus PO requirements and invoicing cadence — question

Hi Sara,

Thanks for the template — good questions. High-level summary and options below so procurement/legal can pick the pattern that fits your ERP and payment runs:

Required PO fields (minimum)
- PO number (must appear on invoice)
- Payer legal entity name (line-level tagging supported)
- BU / cost center (optional but recommended for correct chargeback)
- SKU / product code or subscription line description (one invoice line per SKU recommended)

Invoice cadence options
- Monthly consolidated (preferred) — Redwood can consolidate line items across multiple POs into a single monthly invoice if each PO line includes the legal entity ID. Invoice will include line-level entity tags for your ERP.
- Weekly / ad-hoc — supported but increases unit accounting overhead and may impact per-token billing reconciliation

Net terms and discounts
- Standard public terms: net30 by default for self-serve customers
- For enterprise: we can accommodate net60 with two conditions: (1) PO references per-entity line mapping, and (2) invoicing is consolidated on a monthly EOM schedule.
- Early-payment discount: we can offer a 2% discount if payment settles within 10 days (net10) on consolidated invoices — final approval from finance required.

Next steps / asks from your side
- Can you confirm whether CarePlus will send a single master PO that references each legal entity line-by-line, or if you prefer separate POs per legal entity?
- If master PO, please ensure each line has a legal entity identifier so our invoice can reconcile to your ERP.

I've attached a short pricing matrix that shows how charges will group on a monthly invoice and where discounts will apply. Marissa (AM) and Vanessa (Finance) are on copy to help close the commercial terms and confirm the early-pay discount cadence.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-matrix.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@careplushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@careplushealth.com, accounts.payable@careplushealth.com
Date: 2026-07-12T13:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: CarePlus PO requirements and invoicing cadence — question

Logan — thanks for the quick summary, that helps. A few clarifications from our side:

- CarePlus will issue a single master PO that references three legal entities (CarePlus North, CarePlus Central, CarePlus Clinical) with line items tagged to each legal entity.
- We need the invoice to be consolidated monthly (EOM cutoff on last calendar day) and payable on net60 for this contract.
- Procurement can approve the 2% early-payment discount for net10 if Finance confirms it's automatable in our ERP; please confirm Redwood will apply the discount to the consolidated invoice if payment is received within 10 days of the invoice date.

I'll attach an updated PO with example line-level entity tags and share it with our AP team so they know the expected invoice format. Once we have formal confirmation from Redwood Finance on the discount and the need for any EDI/ERP mapping docs, procurement will issue the PO.

Sara
Sara Nolan
Sr. Procurement Manager
CarePlus Health
[Attachment: careplus_po_template.pdf (updated)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@careplushealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T16:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: CarePlus PO requirements and invoicing cadence — question

Sara — appreciate the clarity, and welcome aboard. Confirmations from Redwood:

1) Invoice and PO handling
- We will accept a single master PO that references multiple legal entities so long as each line item includes the legal entity identifier. Our billing system will include line-level entity tags on the consolidated monthly invoice to support your ERP mappings.

2) Net terms and discount
- We approve net60 for this agreement given the monthly EOM invoice cadence.
- Redwood Finance (Vanessa) flagged the early-pay incentive: we can apply a 2% discount if the consolidated invoice is paid within 10 calendar days. Vanessa, please confirm any tagging or GL requirements we should include on the invoice.

3) Operational items / next steps
- Can your AP team confirm the GL mapping format your ERP needs (CSV sample or EDI spec)? If EDI is required, we'll route to our integrations team — otherwise CSV line mapping is supported out-of-the-box.
- We'll prepare a short amendment to the SOW/Order form to capture net60 and the 2% early-pay term; I'll route a DocuSign for signature once we have the PO attached.

Marissa will coordinate the customer onboarding kickoff once the PO is in place.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this spun up.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF)]
